title: [Bug][Subscription Billing] Price Update Template filters on Subscription Lines are overwritten by the proposal's own default filters
summary: Price Update Template filters on Subscription Lines are now correctly preserved instead of being overwritten by default filters. Two defects in the filter application logic were fixed: mandatory filters now use a separate filter group to intersect with template filters, and the Subscription Line record parameter is passed by reference to carry filters correctly.
key_points: Mandatory default filters moved to FilterGroup(2) so they intersect with template filters instead of replacing them field by field
Subscription Line record parameter changed from pass-by-value to pass-by-reference to preserve caller's filters
Removed dead code checking Closed field since it's now a mandatory default filter
Added comprehensive tests covering filter preservation, filter intersection, and exclusion scenarios
Fixes issue where filtered-out subscription lines were still included in price update proposals
